headline: Shrenik Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process; first CoC meeting notice issued
sum: Shrenik Limited has initiated a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The company notified the NSE of the first Committee of Creditors (CoC) meeting, marking formal entry into formal insolvency proceedings.
implication: CIRP commencement triggers mandatory disclosure obligations under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR and Rule 6 of IBC (Insolvency Resolution) Rules, 2016; all material updates (CoC meetings, resolution plans, administrator reports) must be filed with exchanges within 24 hours.
detail: Shrenik Limited, a listed entity on NSE, has formally entered Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The company intimated the NSE regarding the prior notice of the 1st meeting of its Committee of Creditors. This marks the initiation of the formal CIRP window, during which creditors will assess the company's viability and consider resolution plans. The CoC meeting is a mandatory governance gate under IBC Section 21, where creditors vote on key decisions including admission of resolution plans, extension of timeline, and conversion to liquidation.
